newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends lower on loose funds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends lower on loose funds.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate finished lower on Tuesday as liquidity loosened after funds continued to return to the banking system, and dealers saw little room for the rate to rise in the near term.

The overnight interbank rate closed at 4.778 percent against Monday's 4.808 end, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 4.75-4.80. Dealers expected the money rates to remain at around current levels on Wednesday.
The bond market was cautious as most investors took a wait and see attitude ahead of Friday's government bond auction.
